info.title: cxdbg - ask a running SharpConsoleUI application what it is doing.
info.description: Attach to a running SharpConsoleUI application over its diagnostics socket and ask it what it is doing: what the screen shows, what layout believes, why a control is the size it is. Drives the app too - keys, clicks, resizes - through its own input dispatch.

options.name: --socket
options.description: Which application. Found automatically when only one is running

options.name: --json
options.description: The reply as the protocol sent it, instead of formatted

options.name: --no-color
options.description:
No colour, however the output is going
cxdbg help <verb>   for one verb and its fields.
